description:
Issue or verify a W3C Verifiable Credential.

    Args:
        action: Either "issue" or "verify"
        subject_did: DID of the credential subject (required for "issue")
        credential_type: Type of credential (default: "AgentTrustCredential", only for "issue")
        credential: JSON string of the credential to verify (required for "verify")

credential.description: JSON string of the credential to verify (required for "verify")
credential.title: Credential

subject_did.description: DID of the credential subject (required for "issue"), e.g. did:moltrust:a1b2c3d4e5f60718
subject_did.title: Subject Did

name: moltrust_credential
